sources.quote: Midland Hispanic Chamber of Commerce | local small businesses | 208 South Marienfeld Street, Midland, TX, USA top of page Log In Log In Your Partner in Progress The Midland Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (MHCC) is a dynamic organization dedicated to fostering economic growth for our members and the city of Midland. We champion opportunity by providing essential resources, creating powerful connections through our events, and advocating for your success. Our Mission Empowering Growth, Embracing Hispanic Heritage. Unidos en Progreso. The Midland Hispanic Chamber of Commerce is the vital hub for connecting, developing, and promoting Hispanic-owned and community-focused businesses in Midland, Texas. Join Our Community Unlock Your Potential. Elevate Your Business. Joining the MHCC gives you immediate access to a powerful network and invaluable resources designed to help your Midland business thrive. Become a Member Strategic Networking Connect with influential leaders and potential clients at our exclusive events, from our monthly Café con Pan networking to our annual Awards Gala. Business Advocacy Gain a powerful voice as we advocate for policies that support small business growth and economic development right here in Midland. Enhanced Visibility Increase your exposure through our online directory, event sponsorships, member spotlights, and celebrated ribbon-cutting ceremonies.
